source: Complete pinned native CoEvoSkills controller and minimum original-byte closure; public shared pipeline, tests, fixed corpus and v6 handoff configurations
source_manifest_sha256_definition: SHA256 of canonical JSON list of sorted {path,sha256,bytes} entries under experiment src/ and scripts/
readiness_scope: Native-controller implementation evidence only; no v6 full-85 environment admission or paid model result
omitted: historical packets and full old runs
required_preparation: Select a working Docker daemon and record its endpoint; use the handoff commands to prepare the pinned task environment on the receiving machine
Supply Bedrock credentials locally, and provide the independent OpenAI task credential for pg-essay-to-audiobook; this task remains NOT_READY without it
Fetch the pinned official task source, inputs, environments and private graders using the existing preparation command
Install and verify pinned native Codex and code-mode-host, embedding dependencies and receiving-machine runtime identities
Run fresh full-85 admission for the v6 source identity; historical v4/v5 lock files do not establish v6 readiness
Run a paid single-task smoke for EACH configured model and verify real transport/model compatibility before starting either full matrix
implementation_limitations: Frozen shared retrieval and one untested S0 remain experimental changes.
GT test_details are not forwarded into native controller; learning remains boolean oracle rather than original coarse GT-derived labels. This is documented, not exact feedback parity.

Public-input baseline plus verifier adapter prompt changes runtime instruction, while original vendor prompt bytes remain unchanged. This reduces known missing-baseline/unconditional-fail cases but cannot prove suite semantics.
Shared MAIN and independent model sessions provide author-style observational access, not physical Skill-source isolation. Native diagnosis lacks initial generation equivalent source-read audit.
Host context admission and bounded terminal previews are explicit transport adaptations. The role client independently enforces its configured token limit.
Incomplete started native run cannot be resumed by repeating setup/run. Complete results reuse Journal; interrupted run requires a new trial, and UNKNOWN never redispatches.

Codex subscription transport can prove at most one observable S0 turn, not one underlying HTTP POST; retries remain NOT_OBSERVABLE. Its actual model and transport must be separate from Bedrock matrix.
Real-model compatibility, task reward improvement and all-85 readiness remain unmeasured by Docker/mock fixtures.
Old three completed samples and future two repaired samples are separate source/trial identities and must not be merged as one homogeneous five-task result.
